visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair, wearing a grey furry ushanka-style hat and a dark coat, looks directly into the camera lens while speaking. The background is a blurred night scene with warm golden bokeh from distant festive lights. (2) The scene cuts to a wider shot where the woman turns clockwise while holding two large pretzels. She is in a bustling Christmas market with wooden stalls and a brightly lit "Christmas Market" sign. Crowds of people in winter clothing walk in the background. (3) A tall, triangular Christmas tree stands outdoors at night, covered in thousands of warm white LED lights and large silver ornaments. Several people are visible as dark silhouettes at the base of the tree, looking up at its glowing peak. (4) Tokyo Tower is visible in the distance, illuminated with red, green, and white festive lights. In the foreground, the roof of a wooden Christmas market stall is decorated with green garlands, red baubles, and artificial candles under a dark night sky. (5) A close-up shows a piece of cake with white cream and a red "Christmas Market" sticker on a golden plate. Market stalls and people are blurred in the background. (6) A low-angle shot shows a modern architectural space called "Tower Plaza" with white, undulating ceiling structures. Festive market stalls are arranged on the ground level, and people move through the brightly lit open-air commercial area. (7) A long street is lined with numerous bare trees, each densely wrapped in cool white fairy lights. Cars with glowing headlights and taillights move down the road, which leads toward the illuminated Tokyo Tower in the far distance. (8) A group of people stand at night, holding up their smartphones to photograph a brilliantly lit street scene. The screens of the phones show the glowing white lights and the silhouette of the Tokyo Tower. (9) A large black banner hangs under a glass roof featuring red and green geometric patterns and text reading "ROPPONGI HILLS Christmas Market 2025", indicating a holiday event in a public space. (10) A wide shot shows the entrance to a crowded market area decorated with glowing stars and garlands. The space is filled with people in winter coats walking toward various wooden stalls under a large, modern canopy structure. (11) A street is transformed into a sea of blue light, with every tree on both sides covered in intense blue LEDs. Large crowds of people walk through the center of the illuminated path. (12) The woman reappears standing in the middle of the blue-lit street. She turns her head to look back at the camera with a bright smile, her blue scarf and dark coat blending into the vibrant blue atmosphere. (13) The video concludes with a static, centered shot of the Tokyo Tower decorated with red and green lights against the black night sky, symbolizing the holiday season in the city.
